title: Quantized MLA latent with Mirror gauge
hypothesis: Compact Mirror gauge selection before int4 quantization lowers MLA latent cache attention distortion beyond identity, Hadamard and direct matched rotation controls.
mirror_coordinate: block-Givens gauge selected before int4 quantization

fresh.reason: Direct rotation control gets identical angle search budget.

storage.authority: actual deterministic packed int4 payload bytes

success_gate: Mirror lowers attention-output nMSE >=10% vs identity and Hadamard at <=5% byte overhead and beats direct rotation control.
failure_gate: No quality/storage frontier improvement or direct matched control ties Mirror.
boundaries: no real MLA or GPU kernel claim
Query probes were split 32/32; angle selection used only the first half and reported metric uses held-out queries.
